Title: Keycard Crate Bypass
Description: Skip the 15-minute hack on a Hackable Locked Crate: aim at it with a green keycard and press fire. Each unlock burns 25% of the card's durability.
HowTo: Hold a green keycard as your active item.
Look at a Hackable Locked Crate from within 3 meters.
Press primary fire — the crate finishes hacking within a second.
Loot it as normal. Four unlocks breaks the card.
Notes: Crates at Radtown can't be bypassed.
The normal hack alert still fires — other players are alerted exactly as with a real hack.
